model_output.summary: Implemented toll payment in the Boss case of ADDDemoDirector::HandleInteract. Added a bTollPaid member. Q (bAlt) with Gold >= TollGold subtracts exactly TollGold, sets bTollPaid, and shows bandit_boss_toll_paid_01 plus the log_toll_paid line. Q with less gold shows bandit_boss_cannot_pay_01 and takes no gold, and the way stays barred. After payment, Q gives a short 'already paid' message and charges nothing, so double charging is impossible. No faction favor is touched. The boss prompt drops the pay hint once paid. The strings come from BanditStrings, filled by the existing BossLine.
model_output.connection: The player presses Q facing the boss. ADDDemoCharacter::AltInteract calls Target->Interact(true), which calls ADDDemoDirector::HandleInteract(Target, true). That reaches the EDDDemoKind::Boss case, where the boss is spawned by the director at boss_room. bTollPaid is public to the director for DD-DESC-01 to read.
model_output.unverified: I did not build or play. I did not confirm that bandit_boss_toll_paid_01, bandit_boss_cannot_pay_01 and log_toll_paid are all loaded into BanditStrings. I assumed the existing loader reads every row of bandit_strings.csv and did not read it. The 'already paid' and 'Toll's paid' lines are my own placeholder text, not from the CSV. The HUD display of messages was not checked.
